profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Coachieve: JavaScript, React, Redux, Rails, MongoDB, Express.js, PostgreSQL, AWS, GraphQL, Apex
profile.summary:
I am a software engineer with interest in building web applications using JavaScript.  I have my favorite technologies include React / Redux, and Rails.  I love building apps that handle big data and display it in a visually helpful way. I am currently building a web note-taking application using React JS and Redux on the front-end and Ruby on Rails as a back-end API.

More personally I have been passionate about computers from a young age. One of my favorite childhood memories was building a screensaver in basic in primary school. As I grew I  always was fascinated with Computer Technology and how it worked.  

I went to college to get a degree in Information Technology. During that time, my favorite classes were in java programming. I really enjoyed building small applications in class such as a budget calculator and a data visualization applet.

Some of my other skills include Ruby, SQL, D3, Chrome Dev Tools, Bash, jQuery and Native JavaScript DOM manipulation.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built out a single page application that allows a user to create many recurring Evenbrite events using their API.

Built a graphql schema, integrating a NoSQL database with a third-party API. This allows the client to seamlessly access the client as if it were one API.

 Implements a detailed form that handles basic info, scheduling, details and handling tickets

positions.title: Electrician
positions.description:
Managed construction teams in building and remodeling multi-million dollar homes, organizing a team to meet county and city construction ordinances and building regulations.

Constructed many high priority projects simultaneously while reaching project milestones, all within project timelines and budget scope.

positions.title: Inventory Specialist
positions.description:
Developed and implemented merchandising strategies in order to improve high-ticket sales on products with higher profit margins.
 Led a team of merchandising associates in three building remodels, completing the remodel on time and under budget.
I worked closely with team members on the sales floor to facilitate relations with customers.
I merchandised the sales floor with products.

I coordinated the shipping and receiving and inventory of merchandise at the store level.

positions.title: Sales Clerk
positions.description:
Assisted Customers with purchases and purchasing decisions.
Manned the cash register.
Stocked Shelves with products

projects.title: Event Tool
projects.description: Tool to create recurring eventbrite events. Technologies include React, Graphql, Grommet, ExpressJS and MongoDb .

projects.title: StockNFo
projects.description:
Responsive portfolio research application.	           
Integrated live API calls using vanilla JavaScript’s fetch methods.
Built custom info data visualizations, parsing  asynchronous JSON data and drawing a pie-chart and line-graph using the chart,js graph library  library.
Built out a stock class using JavaScript ES6 class syntax that keeps track of the price history and number of shares of each stock.
